notes: Portrait, straight-on, four shelves of a library friends' book-sale case (Alameda County Library Foundation signage top left) under flat indoor light, no glare; a folded-book sculpture and a plant pot sit on top. Paperbacks are shelved by colour (dark, pink/red, blue, green/black), all English. Photo is 1200x1600 so the smaller spines need zooming but most read. Repeats (Power Play, The Last Beach Bungalow, Princess Elizabeth's Spy, Einstein in the Attic x3) are labelled once. Partial: The Night Ranger (Berenson, title partly hidden by the neighbour), The Evening Gone (small tan spine, second shelf, only part of the title reads), The Seduction of Water (Carol Goodman, faint type). Left out: about twenty spines whose type is too small or too low-contrast at this size (among them the pale pink 'Understanding' book far left of shelf 2, the Ian Karon and Corbett spines, the Lindsey Davis and Stephanie Laurens neighbours on shelf 4, the Stephen Coonts titles after Saucer, the Laura Lippman spine, the yellow book leaning at the right of shelf 3, and the Anne Herries romance whose title is only faintly legible), and the picture-book propped on top of the case. The draft's 'Faithless', 'The 6:20 Man', 'The Scorpion's Tail', 'A Grave Mistake', 'Hall of Jecuvid', 'The Prague Cemetery' and 'Most of Here' were misreadings and are replaced by the printed titles.
